2026-11-10: cause narrowed. SiteRoot rendered the SCAN-895 pre-paint script only when the resolved page was unlocked, so an ISR page regenerated under a pathname that resolved to the locked fallback differed structurally from the client's Home render (#418). The script is now always rendered (it skips a locked root itself) and an effect writes the client's page attributes after mount. The trigger that made a regeneration see a non-'/' pathname is still unknown; reopen if #418 recurs on /. 2026-11-16 server-side test of the theory, on production (read-only, no browser). What: GET /, /pricing and /the-community through the Vercel fetch tool, 6, 6 and 7 times, spread over 16:02 to 16:06 UTC, then a token-level diff of the server HTML between fetches of the same page. Readings: / PRERENDER age 0, then HIT at age 57, 117, 150, 165, then PRERENDER age 0; /pricing PRERENDER 0, PRERENDER 0, HIT 59, 92, 107, PRERENDER 0; /the-community PRERENDER 0, HIT 15, 58, 117, 150, 165, PRERENDER 0. The three resets to age 0 are three production deployments going live inside the window (dpl_DTPt..., dpl_6ESoz..., dpl_FTy8...), not cache misses. Result: within one deployment every fetch of a page is byte-identical (same ETag). Across deployments the only differences are the deployment id and the hashed chunk file names (16 hunks on /pricing, all of that kind); with those two masked, all 19 responses collapse to one document per page. No date, clock, random id, nonce, locale-formatted number or time-ago string differs between responses. The kit root the server rendered matches the route every time: /pricing data-side e, data-lock e, mood pricing; /the-community data-side p, data-lock p, mood people; / data-side p, no lock, mood home, so the wrong-pathname regeneration named on 2026-11-10 was not observed. Source read for render-time browser or clock reads on the two pages and their shared chrome: components/frequency/site/shell/site-footer.tsx:83 prints new Date().getFullYear() (a Server Component, so it can only go stale at a year boundary inside the ISR hour, not mismatch); components/frequency/site/pages/people/frequency-people.tsx:161 and :167 use toLocaleString('en-US') with a fixed locale in a Server Component (safe; the page shows 35 Circles and 24 events this week, baked for the ISR hour); lib/pricing/beta.ts:57 isBetaPricingActive(new Date()) and lib/page-editor/live-data.ts:98 run on the server at regeneration only; components/frequency/site/pages/pricing/pricing-calculator.tsx:366 and :423 read matchMedia inside an effect and an event handler, not in render. The client components that do read browser state in render all go through useSyncExternalStore with a server snapshot: components/frequency/site/shell/site-root.tsx:98 (the chosen side, with suppressHydrationWarning on the root at :169) and components/frequency/site/shell/site-header.tsx:175 (the fq_acct cookie marker). The header also derives markup from usePathname (site-header.tsx:151 to :153, wingOf and feedHomeLink at :176), which is the remaining place a server and client pathname disagreement would show. Reading: the server HTML is stable, so a server-side cause is not supported by this sample; what is left is client-only (a returning visitor with a stored side or the account cookie, or a page loaded across a deployment swap, which happened three times in four minutes here). What remains: the row's own probe, a real browser run of node scripts/audit/route-family-audit.mjs --routes /pricing,/the-community on a production build, ideally with localStorage fq-home-side and the fq_acct cookie set and at 390 and 1280. Row stays OPEN.

2026-11-16 NOT REPRODUCED on production with the row's own method: 20 cold loads per page and viewport with a console listener, /pricing, /the-community and / at 390 and 1280, 0 hydration errors and 0 other console errors in 120 loads (e2e-manual run 43938516828). With 0/24 on 2026-11-10 and byte-stable server HTML within a deployment, the two audit #418s were one-offs, most likely a load that straddled a deployment swap. Closed with no code change.

verify.evidence: 0 hydration errors in 120 cold loads on production (20 each for /pricing, /the-community and / at 390 and 1280), e2e-manual run 43938516828 job 133549442468, field-measure.spec.ts hydration test with a console listener. Reading in docs/perf/public-cwv-baseline.md. Reopen if a #418 shows again.
